body:
Part of #125. **Re-scoped 2026-08-28 after PR #135 (`f25bbb8`) landed** — it already rewrote
`README.md`, `docs/harnesses.md` and the wiki for the new recording model. Do not redo the docs.

## What remains — the doctor check

The gap that started this track was found by an empty spend report, weeks late. `hkb doctor` should
be able to say it directly.

- Per `claude-bg` profile that has run attempts on this board: warn when **no** ended attempt carries
  `session_id`, with the fix (`hkb` is older than #135: `npm i -g hkb-cli@latest`; or the harness is
  not stamping — check `$CLAUDE_JOB_DIR`).
- Warn when attempts ended without a verb (`crashed`/`timed_out`/`protocol_violation`) carry no
  session, and #132 has not landed — name #132's mechanism once it has.
- Say, per profile, whether hkb's PreToolUse policy is live there (it is not on `claude-bg` unless
  #133 (b) ships) — one line, so the operator knows which layer is enforcing.
- Docs: only if `docs/harnesses.md` after #135 is missing the "which layer enforces" line; otherwise
  leave it.

## Done when

- `hkb doctor` on a board whose `claude-bg` attempts carry no session fields warns and names the fix;
  on this board after #135 it says ok for verb-ended attempts.
- `node --test test/doctor.test.js` covers warn and ok with a deterministic board fixture.

## Contract

- Read `hkb show` on what this is blocked by; touch only `src/doctor.js`, `test/doctor.test.js`,
  and `docs/harnesses.md` if genuinely stale.
goal: hkb doctor warns on a board whose claude-bg attempts carry no session fields
title: doctor says when a profile's hooks are inert, and the docs say what each profile really runs
